boundary_controls: 20 retained in original judge bundle; not prediction targets
limitations: Group mapping catches declared templates/exact normalized duplicates, not all semantic near-duplicates.
Shared early histories are label-free prefix states; report overlap and never fit transformations on tune/check labels.
All cases have prior development exposure; exploratory_check is not untouched confirmatory data.
Single AI labels, few negatives and selected proposal pool do not establish false-speculation risk or causal public/synthetic effects.
